meaning_by_symbol.BC: bell center of each face once
meaning_by_symbol.BO-nx5: bell opposite faces alternating, with n-second pauses, for 5 cycles

reply.rationale: No defensible multi-entry paradigm survives the evidence tests. The strongest surface recurrence is final n / -n in Rn, CCn, FA6-n, FTB-n, BSTn, WCTn, LDBn, and FBPn, but this does not show a substitution class for that slot: only one duration variable form is attested, with no contrasting fillers in the same frame. The remaining residues before n are heterogeneous stored procedures, and grouping them into a generic action-root class would violate the instruction against creating a broad residual ROOT class without a tighter productive paradigm. Other repeated pieces (such as T, B, F, or digits) fail the opaque-index/compositional tests across the supplied whole-code meanings. Therefore the safest complete partition is a flat lexicon.
